God Tier Aldi Products

I have been thinking about the things that I love from Aldi — both because of their price and quality. Things I don’t have on this list are products I buy for a discount, but are not unique to Aldi (mini diet cokes , orange juice, frozen fruit, etc). My list: Emporium white cheddar cheese Sourdough round (fuck the sourdough loaf) Specialty coffee or chocolate flavored ice cream Clancy’s pub style pretzels hash brown sleeve (20 pack 😳) honeycrisp apples (for the price, ik this doesn’t really belong on the list) -Gfree sweet chili brown rice chips What else is on your Aldi God tier? 4
